items.title: Optimizing Design and Development Workflows with Figma, Cursor, and Claude MCP
items.description: How to create a seamless bridge between design and code using Figma, Cursor, and Claude MCP to dramatically reduce friction in the design-to-development workflow.

items.title: Building Design Systems That Scale
items.description: Lessons learned from creating and maintaining design systems for large organizations. How to balance consistency with flexibility and keep your system relevant as products evolve.

items.title: The Art of Micro-Interactions
items.description: Why the smallest details matter most. Exploring how thoughtful micro-interactions can transform a good user experience into a delightful one, with practical examples and implementation strategies.

items.title: Accessibility Beyond Compliance
items.description: Moving from checking boxes to creating truly inclusive experiences. A deep dive into accessibility as a design philosophy, not just a requirement, with real-world case studies.

items.title: Data-Driven Design Decisions
items.description: How to balance user research, analytics, and intuition when making design decisions. Practical frameworks for synthesizing multiple data sources into actionable insights.

items.title: Prototyping in the Age of AI
items.description: How AI tools are changing the prototyping landscape. From rapid iteration to intelligent component generation, exploring the new possibilities and maintaining design quality.
